status: authored 2026-09-30; overrides only, no coordinates, nothing placed in a world
consumed_by: tools/route_trainers.py, which emits the five overrides into build/datapacks/cobblers_trainers
why_overrides_and_not_seats: The League is not ours to furnish. data/structures.json (cobbleverse:kanto_league, read from COBBLEVERSE-DP-v31.zip) records that the 111x159x120 template already carries five rctmod:trainer_spawner blocks locked to kanto_league_lorelei, kanto_league_bruno, kanto_league_agatha, kanto_league_lance and kanto_champion_blue, and docs/world-building/STRUCTURE_INVENTORY.md says the same. Our campaign is already bound to those upstream ids rather than to ours: data/progression.json's champion_cleared flag is set by defeating kanto_champion_blue, exactly as gym1_cleared is set by kanto_brock. So the way our five authored teams reach a player is to override the upstream ids' team data at the upstream path (.claude/rules/datapacks.md), which is what data/progression.json's upstream_neutralised already does for the same trainers' loot tables. Seating five new trainers at hand-chosen coordinates would need the template's interior geometry, which is not in this repo at all -- the template is placed by resource id from the installed pack and never copied in -- and would leave the template's own five spawners in the rooms beside them.
measured_from: data/placements.json league_building: pack_template cobbleverse:kanto_league at (3754, 88, 2375), rotation clockwise_90, anchor corner, size [111, 159, 120], so the building occupies x3635-3754 z2375-2485 with its floor at y88 and its entrance facing south down Victory Road's arrival. data/placements.json settlements.league puts that arrival at (3656, 2486), three blocks from the door. Every seat lies inside that box; none is measured from a world save.
order_enforced_by: The template, not by us. docs/world-building/STRUCTURE_INVENTORY.md: 'The league is one 111x159x120 template with five trainer spawners (Lorelei, Bruno, Agatha, Lance, Blue). A LumyMon elevator in it requires the advancement cobbleverse:trainer/kanto/defeat_elite_lance' -- so the Champion's floor cannot be reached until Lance is beaten, and data/structures.json carries that same advancement as the structure's one required_advancement. The four rooms run in order ahead of it. Overriding only the team and the dialogue leaves every gate, door and spawner upstream's, so the order we inherit is the order Cobbleverse built.
order_not_verified: What gates rooms 1 to 4 from one another inside the template has not been read out of the template here, only the elevator's advancement has. The repo does not hold the template's blocks. An in-game walk of the League (and a look at whether a beaten room's door stays open for a second player at a different point in the order) is the only thing that settles it.
not_emitted: Deliberately not written for these five: the rctmod mob file (upstream's spawner owns how each is spawned, and a spawnWeightFactor 0 override could break it), a loot table (the Champion's is already emptied by data/progression.json upstream_neutralised; the four elites' upstream tables are left alone, which is that unit's call and not this one's), an advancement (champion_cleared already fires from kanto_champion_blue through tools/progression_pack.py), and any entry in tools/route_trainers.py placements(), because there is no seat for tools/reapply.py to summon at.
